question: Should maintainers keep this stale external PR as the candidate fix, or close/replace it while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/46894 canonical?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but this same-author PR is paired with an open canonical issue, lacks external real behavior proof, and needs command-semantics changes that should not be repaired or closed without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace with a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Keep the issue canonical, close or supersede stale PR attempts when ready, and land a current-main patch matching documented list/status behavior.

options.title: Ask this contributor to revise
options.body: Keep this PR open and request a rebase, documented command routing, and after-fix Control UI proof from the contributor.

options.title: Accept the summary-only behavior
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally make `list` and `status` summary aliases, but that requires updating docs and shared command expectations.

recommendation.title: Replace with a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Keep the issue canonical, close or supersede stale PR attempts when ready, and land a current-main patch matching documented list/status behavior.
